Content: The day will come that you will be sorry.
Pila ka adlaw makapánaw ta sa búwan,
Soon we’ll be able to take trips to the moon.
Singku ra may íyang adlaw niánà,
He only gets five pesos a day from it.
Muadlaw kug tagduha ka líbu ka písus,
I net two thousand pesos a day.
Pay him ten pesos per day.
Adtu nyà sa ámù kay mag-adlaw ku,
Come to my house for my birthday party.
Ayaw úsà pagpaúli. Adláwan pa bítaw,
Don’t go home yet! It’s still daylight anyway.
food used to celebrate a birthday with.
Sa buntag tiadlaw, apan sa hápun nag-ulan,
In the morning it was sunny, but in the afternoon it rained.
